question: Approve to ideation: shape the fix for gate rooms making a flat entity a hybrid?

artifacts.summary: A retained room-ref is written relative to the entity file's directory, so converting flat to folder resolves every ref to <slug>/<slug>/review/... and one consumed historical attempt makes all later gates unpreparable (io.go:207). The deeper fault is the form: gate prepare on a flat entity creates a <slug>/ directory beside <slug>.md, and all 10 flat gated entities here are already that hybrid. gate record --round already refuses non-folder form for this exact reason (operation.go:108), and the validator already rejects both-forms slugs but not flat-plus-rooms. Ideation weighs enforce-and-migrate at prepare against tolerant read-side resolution.
